text:
Emma (Marketing): Quick check — finalizing the partner collateral bundle for NebulaCloud. Need final decisions on: logo lockups (horizontal + stacked), badge placement, alt text for all images, and a one-line customer quote for the case study. Can we get assets + approvals this week?

Raj Patel: @Emma noted. Legal needs a signed logo permission form from Nebula before we publish. Also flag: they prefer the co-brand lockup to have Nebula on the left. Avoid using their full product name as trademark without attribution.

Sophie Li: Attached example alt text suggestions (can paste into Figma copy fields):
- hero-graphic.jpg: "Developer integrating Redwood Inference with NebulaCloud VPC on a laptop"
- arch-diagram.png: "High-level flow: app -> Redwood routing -> NebulaCloud GPU pool (private)"
- customer-quote-photo.jpg: "Portrait: Riley from AtlasHealth"

Sophie Li: Quick design notes — prefer stacked lockup for narrow hero, horizontal for footer. Also include 1px clearspace = half logo height.

Marcos - Partner Ops: Timeline: I can get Nebula legal to sign logo use by Thu EOD if we send the permission template now. I’ll own the final asset handoff.

Emma (Marketing): Great. For the one-line customer quote we have two candidate phrasings:
- "Redwood + Nebula gave us consistent low-latency inference for clinical workflows."
- "Switching to Redwood on NebulaCloud cut our inference tail latency by half."
Which is safer from a claims POV?

Raj Patel: Second one implies a measurable reduction — need approval from AtlasHealth to include numbers. Use the first phrasing unless we get explicit permission for metrics.

Sophie Li: I updated the Figma with badge placement options and alt text fields: https://figma.com/file/xyz (see pages: Collateral / Final). Suggested badge copy: "Supported on NebulaCloud" — avoid any phrase like "Certified by" unless partner okays.

BrandBot: Automated checklist reminder: 
- logo files: `nebula-logo.svg`, `nebula-logo-white.svg`, `nebula-mark.svg`
- required formats: ```svg, png@2x, eps, pdf```
- alt text present (Y/N)
- signed permission (Y/N)
- quote cleared (Y/N)

Marcos - Partner Ops: I'll upload Nebula-signed-logo-perm.pdf and the high-res logos to the partnership drive by Wed morning.

Emma (Marketing): Perfect. Action items:
- @Marcos upload permissions + logos (Wed AM)
- @Sophie update Figma alt text and export lockup PNGs (Wed PM)
- @Raj confirm legal ok for final quote language (Thu)

Sophie Li: Will also prepare two badge color variants (light/dark) and alt text spreadsheet.

Raj Patel: :thumbsup: If anything risky pops up, loop me in early.

Emma (Marketing): Thanks all — will draft final case one-pager after assets come in. :eyes:
